title: 第15章 新生第16章 影杀之局
slug: 丹尊至上第391章驿站交接
content_zh:
百兽风谷之内，血腥与硝烟的气息，在寂静的空气中缓缓弥漫。
那头曾不可一世的铁背地龙熊，此刻如同泄了气的皮球，庞大的身躯趴伏在地，每一次呼吸，都带着沉重的喘息声。
它体表那坚不可摧的岩石铠甲，已是布满裂痕，黯淡无光；那双曾燃起狂暴火焰的眼眸，也只剩下无尽的虚弱与疲惫。
“天哥，这大家伙快不行了，”
朱有福看着那头奄奄一息的庞然大物，艰难地咽了口口水，小声问道，“咱们……是上去收了它的妖核吗？这可是二阶顶峰的变异妖兽，它的妖核能炼制好几种玄阶丹药呢！
这一身熊皮熊骨，也都是上好的炼器材料啊！”
他的话，说出了在场所有人的心声。
杀了它，取其材料，这是修士在秘境中最常规，也是利益最大化的选择。
然而，林天却缓缓摇了摇头，嘴角，反而勾起了一抹让所有人都看不懂的、意味深长的笑容。
“一具尸体，价值几何？”
他轻笑一声，目光中带着一丝俯瞰众生的淡然，“材料终有用尽之时。
而一个活着的、堪比筑基修士的盟友，其价值，又是多少？”
在众人惊愕的目光中，林天竟独自一人，迈着从容的步伐，缓缓地，向着那头虽然虚弱、却依旧散发着致命危险气息的巨兽，走了过去。
“吼……”
地龙熊感受到了生人的靠近，它艰难地抬起头，喉咙里发出一阵低沉的、充满警告意味的咆哮。
它挣扎着想要站起，却连抬起爪子的力气都没有。
“别紧张，大家伙。”
一道温和而平静的声音，并非从口中发出，而是如同清泉般，直接在他的脑海中响起。
这是……神识传音！
地龙熊那巨大的瞳孔，猛地一缩！

它虽然灵智不高，却也明白，能够如此清晰地与它进行灵魂沟通的，绝非普通的人类修士！
林天，一步步走到距离它不足三丈的地方，停了下来。
他没有释放任何杀气，只是用一种平等的、仿佛在与老朋友对话般的眼神，看着它。
“我能感觉到你的痛苦，你的不甘。”
林天的神识，如同温暖的阳光，安抚着它狂躁的灵魂，“你守护了百年的果实被人毁掉，又被当成棋子，去攻击另一群让你讨厌的家伙。
现在，你油尽灯枯，只能在这里，绝望地等待死亡。”
地龙熊眼中的凶光，渐渐被一丝茫然所取代。
这个渺小的人类，似乎……能看透它的内心？
“但是，”
林天的声音，突然带上了一丝诱惑，“死亡，并非是你唯一的结局。
对我而言，你并非一头简单的妖兽，而是一份……潜力无穷的‘活丹方’。”
“活丹方？”
地龙熊的脑海中，第一次出现了这个陌生的词汇。
“没错。”
林天的声音充满了自信，“你的血脉，驳杂不纯，空有‘地龙’之名，却无‘龙’之实，此生注定无望进阶四阶。
此为‘丹方’之残缺。”
“你的肉身，虽强横，却因修炼功法粗糙，体内暗伤无数，灵力运转多有滞涩。
此为‘丹炉’之破损。”
“而我，”
林天的声音，如同神只的低语，“是一名丹尊。

我不仅能炼制死物丹药，更能……‘炼活人’，‘炼活兽’！”
“现在，我给你一个选择。”
“第一，留在这里，在痛苦与虚弱中，慢慢死去。
content_en:
Within the Beast Wind Valley, the smell of blood and gunpowder smoke slowly filled the silent air.
The once arrogant iron-backed dragon bear was now like a deflated rubber ball, its huge body lying on the ground, and every breath was accompanied by a heavy gasp.
The indestructible rock armor on its body was already full of cracks and dull; the eyes that once ignited with violent flames were only filled with endless weakness and exhaustion.
"Brother Tian, this big guy is dying,"
Zhu Youfu looked at the dying behemoth, swallowed hard, and asked in a low voice, "Are we...going up to collect its demon core? This is a second-level peak mutant demon beast, and its demon core can refine several Xuan-level elixirs!
This bear skin and bear bones are also the best materials for refining weapons! "
His words spoke the thoughts of everyone present.
Killing it and taking its materials is the most common choice for monks in the secret realm, and it is also the choice to maximize profits.
However, Lin Tian slowly shook his head, and a meaningful smile appeared on the corner of his mouth that no one could understand.
"How much is a corpse worth?"
He chuckled lightly, with a hint of indifference in his eyes overlooking all sentient beings, "The materials will eventually be used up.
And what is the value of a living ally who is comparable to a foundation-building monk? "
In the astonished eyes of everyone, Lin Tian was alone, walking slowly and calmly towards the giant beast that, although weak, still exuded a deadly and dangerous aura.
"Roar..."
The Earth Dragon Bear felt the stranger approaching. It raised its head with difficulty and let out a low, warning roar from its throat.
It struggled to stand up, but couldn't even lift its paws.
"Take it easy, big guy."
A gentle and calm voice did not come from his mouth, but sounded directly in his mind like a clear spring.
This is... divine consciousness transmission!
The huge pupils of the Earth Dragon Bear shrank suddenly!
Although it is not very intelligent, it also understands that those who can communicate with its soul so clearly are definitely not ordinary human monks!
Lin Tian walked step by step to a place less than three feet away from it and stopped.
He did not release any murderous intent, but looked at it with an equal expression, as if he was having a conversation with an old friend.
"I can feel your pain and your unwillingness."
Lin Tian's consciousness was like warm sunshine, soothing its manic soul, "The fruit you have been guarding for a hundred years has been destroyed, and then used as a pawn to attack another group of guys that you hate.
Now, you have run out of fuel and can only stay here, desperately waiting for death. "
The ferocious light in Earth Dragon Bear's eyes was gradually replaced by a trace of confusion.
This tiny human seems to... be able to see through its heart?
"But,"
Lin Tian's voice suddenly carried a hint of temptation, "Death is not your only ending.
To me, you are not a simple monster, but a...'living elixir' with unlimited potential. "
"Living elixir recipe?"
For the first time, this unfamiliar word appeared in Dilongxiong's mind.
"That's right."
Lin Tian's voice was full of confidence, "Your bloodline is mixed and impure. It has the name of 'Earth Dragon' but no reality of 'Dragon'. You are destined to have no hope of advancing to the fourth level in this life."
This is the defect of the 'alchemy formula'. "
"Although your physical body is powerful, due to the roughness of your cultivation techniques, you have numerous hidden wounds in your body, and your spiritual power is often stagnant.
This is the damage of the 'Alchemy Furnace'. "
"And I,"
Lin Tian's voice was like the whisper of a god, "He is an alchemist.
Not only can I refine elixirs from dead things, but I can also...'refine living people' and 'refining living animals'! "
"Now, I'll give you a choice."
“First, stay here, die slowly in pain and weakness.
